LEARNED TOPIC COMPARISON
Breadth-first search and Dijkstra's algorithm

Breadth-first search
A FIFO queue explores vertices by increasing edge count. Mark a vertex when enqueuing it. Parent links reconstruct a shortest unweighted path.
O(V+E) time and O(V) auxiliary space.
Watch for: BFS does not minimize arbitrary weighted distances.

Dijkstra's algorithm
Remove the smallest tentative distance from a priority queue and relax its outgoing edges. Nonnegative weights justify finalizing that distance.
O((V+E) log V) with a binary heap.
Watch for: Negative edges invalidate standard finalization.
